local.heading: Dunwoody businesses compete with all of Perimeter Center for one search.
paragraphs: Dunwoody has only been a city since 2008, but it sits on one of the busiest business districts in Georgia. Perimeter Center grew up around I-285 and GA-400, and State Farm's Park Center campus now rises right on top of the Dunwoody MARTA station. That puts tens of thousands of office workers, plus a lot of competing businesses, inside a few miles of each other.

That density is the problem a Dunwoody website has to solve. Search "accountant near me" from an office on Ashford-Dunwoody Road and Google weighs firms in Dunwoody, Sandy Springs, and Brookhaven against each other. A site that never says where you are and who you serve gets lumped in with everyone else. A site that names Perimeter Center, Dunwoody Village, and the neighborhoods you cover gives Google a reason to pick you.

Outside the office towers, Dunwoody is a town of established neighborhoods and long-time residents. Families around Dunwoody Village, Mount Vernon Road, and Winters Chapel hire local contractors, dentists, tutors, and landscapers, and they ask neighbors before they ask Google. When they do search, they're on a phone and they want a phone number, real reviews, and proof you work their side of 285.

So we build Dunwoody sites for both buyers. A professional firm near Perimeter Mall needs a site that looks right to a corporate client on a lunch break. A home service company working Georgetown and Dunwoody North needs pages that name those places and make calling easy.

faqs.q: How much does web design in Dunwoody, GA cost?
faqs.a: Most Dunwoody businesses start with our Local Marketing Package: $297 a month, month to month, with no contract to sign. It includes local SEO, paid ads management if you want ads (your ad budget is separate), and a custom website valued at $3,500 at no extra cost.

faqs.q: Can a Dunwoody business outrank Sandy Springs and Atlanta firms?
faqs.a: For searches made in and around Dunwoody, yes, often. Google leans heavily on location for local searches. A site that clearly says you serve Dunwoody, backed by a complete Google Business Profile and reviews from local customers, competes well against bigger firms that only mention Atlanta.

faqs.q: Will you build pages for Perimeter Center and Dunwoody Village?
faqs.a: If you serve them. We add pages for the parts of Dunwoody and the neighboring cities where you actually take work, each written for that area. We don't pad the site with places you don't cover, because those pages don't convert and Google sees through them.

faqs.q: Do I have to meet in person?
faqs.a: No. Most of the work happens over calls, video, and shared drafts you can click through on your phone. We're in Villa Rica, and we're glad to come to Dunwoody when a sit-down makes the project better.

faqs.q: How long does a new Dunwoody website take?
faqs.a: Most sites launch in a few weeks. The biggest factor is how quickly we get your photos, service details, and feedback on the draft. Local SEO work starts at the same time, so the site launches ready to be found.

faqs.q: I already have a website. Can you fix it instead?
faqs.a: We look at what your current site does well first. If it already ranks for something, we keep that. Most of the time a rebuild is faster and cheaper than patching an old theme, and the free website in the package covers it.
